title: Part 11
content_zh: Li Bai's poetry was not written — it was breathed out. He would drink a gallon of wine, write a hundred poems, then fall asleep in a wine shop in Chang'an. The emperor summoned him, but he could not rise, claiming he was a spirit of wine.
